segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַחוֹבֵל בַּחֲבֵירוֹ, חַיָּיב עָלָיו מִשּׁוּם חֲמִשָּׁה דְּבָרִים: בְּנֶזֶק, בְּצַעַר, בְּרִיפּוּי, בְּשֶׁבֶת וּבוֹשֶׁת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One who injures another is liable» to pay compensation «for that» injury «due to five types» of indemnity: He must pay «for damage, for pain, for medical costs, for loss of livelihood, and» for «humiliation.»

moves.summary: five categories of indemnity for injury

positions.claim: one who injures another pays for damage, pain, medical costs, lost livelihood and humiliation
